message.jaymoskingdoms.steel.unknown: You don't know how to work this.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.steel.step.0: Our iron isn't dug. It's washed. Go where a river runs over sand and gravel, dig under the water, and watch for the black grains that sink first. Bring me a handful and I'll tell you what comes next.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.steel.step.1: That's it. Heavy, isn't it? Now it wants fire, more than a cook's furnace gives. A blast furnace, and patience. What comes out is ugly, a bloom, half slag. Bring me one.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.steel.step.2: Good. Now the work. Lay it on the anvil and strike it out, fold it back on itself, strike again. Six folds drive the slag out and what's left will hold an edge your grandchildren can use. Go on. You know it now.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.steel.wait.1: Words are cheap. Come back with the black sand in your hand.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.steel.wait.2: You haven't burnt it yet. Bring me a bloom.
